inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, Checkbox accepts native <input> attributes (InputHTMLAttributes) except size and type, such as name, value or aria-*. They apply to the <input type="checkbox">; use wrapperClassName for the container.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.label: The label is tied to the input through htmlFor. Without a visible label, pass aria-label.
a11y.describedBy: helperText and errorMessage are linked via aria-describedby; the error uses role="alert".

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on the props. Useful for styling with CSS.

rules.label: <label> element wrapping the control and text.
rules.control: Wraps the input and the visual box.
rules.iconCheck: Check icon for the checked state.
rules.iconMinus: Dash icon for the indeterminate state.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Each tone sets these variables. Redefine them in your `wrapperClassName` to change colors without overriding rules.

items.--gem-checkbox-tone: Border and background of the checked or indeterminate state.
items.--gem-checkbox-tone-active: Border and background on hover while checked.
items.--gem-checkbox-on: Icon color on the checked background.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <input> attributes (except size and type).

items.label: Visible label next to the control.
items.helperText: Hint text below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error copy below the field. Marks it as invalid.
items.tone: Color tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.isDisabled: Disables the field. Prefer it over native disabled.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.className: Extra classes for the native input.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
